original_request.capability: stopAfterTurn and agent_settled boundary

original_request.capability: extension compaction callback completion and failure

original_request.capability: hidden before-user extension initialization, session identity and lifecycle delivery

resolutions.rationale: The supplied factory requires inline ordering, live guarded session identity/context and awaited lifecycle dispatch. The session binding/reload consumer is SESSION-035. Loading and background-drain state remain COG-owned.

original_request.capability: tool-result argument/result payload and session-safe lifecycle contexts

original_request.capability: compaction preparation/reason/signal and host session identity

original_request.capability: session_before_compact override protocol

original_request.capability: post-compaction event details and ordered custom-entry persistence

original_request.capability: tool registration with schema/cancellation/details and active-tool state

resolutions.rationale: Registration, fresh-context execution with signal/details, and active-tool mutation are required. The shared execution validator remains AI-012; provider sampling or successful registration does not validate an invocation.

original_request.capability: namespaced settings descriptors and change callbacks

resolutions.rationale: The named settings descriptor/onChange host API is EXT-016. TUI-025 displays and dispatches those descriptors. Cognee owns its separate JSON persistence and its nonawaited save behavior; these are not core settings.json keys.

original_request.capability: bundled skill discovery through the resource loader

original_request.capability: live Cognee observation projection into the run recorder

original_request.capability: status slots and safe lifecycle of retired UI contexts

resolutions.rationale: The required public capability is keyed setStatus plus stale-context invalidation. TUI-037 owns the footer map/display consumer; it is not a prerequisite for headless or RPC-capable Cognee execution. Cognee owns its 180 ms timer and stale-access catch.

original_request.capability: namespaced registerSettings descriptors/change callbacks

resolutions.rationale: Blackhole registers ordered named settings and callbacks through EXT-016. TUI-025 is the presentation consumer. Blackhole retains responsibility for file values and writes.

original_request.capability: wrapTextWithAnsi display-width and continuation behavior

original_request.capability: compaction cut-ID/retained-tail override and durable context projection

resolutions.rationale: The cut-ID/retained-context contract and branch entry projection are prerequisites. An absent sentinel intentionally drops the old context tail while preserving durable history. Native retained_tail is an explicit adapter choice, not evidence of byte-compatible v3 storage.

original_request.capability: ice-subagent-v2-child durable records and artifact schemas

original_request.capability: session_before_compact preparation and override result

resolutions.rationale: The hook needs full preparation and ordered override/cancel reduction, followed by manual or automatic session-owned persistence/context replacement. The deterministic compiler does not need a second agent loop.

original_request.capability: compactAfterTurn pause/resume scheduling and session_compact acknowledgement

resolutions.rationale: The context exposes compactAfterTurn; SESSION-015 owns boundary request consumption/pause-resume scheduling and SESSION-017 owns accepted automatic compaction and acknowledgement. Blackhole retains its missed-request suppression state.

AI-006 expands request options, and RPC-004 deliberately omits fields. resolutions.rationale: The coding-agent skill loader, refresh signature and trust path are separate from the agent-package helper. They are related integration/parallel-layer contracts, not imports required to implement this helper's exact discovery behavior.

resolutions.rationale: AGENT-061 already owns model-visible invocation/list formatting. SET-031 specifies a distinct coding-agent metadata/listing path, while TUI-030 displays a parsed skill card. Rendering is a downstream concern, not a prerequisite of pure formatting.
